changelog: The new dimension: six kinds of notes (lists, journals, mind maps, sketches, audio), optional accounts that sync your notes between phones, a faster encrypted vault with verified backups, and a second hidden space. Install over this version; don't uninstall first.

desktop.changelog: Notes+ for Windows: all six kinds of notes, synced with your phone through the same account, pictures pasted right into notes and mind maps, and both hidden worlds. No installer: unzip and run.
